title: Observer Output
description: Pure visual description of a dermatology image. NO diagnosis, NO label knowledge.

morphology.description: Primary lesion type and arrangement (e.g., 'solitary well-demarcated plaque', 'grouped vesicles on erythematous base')

color.description: Color description adapted to observed skin tone (e.g., 'salmon pink with silvery-white overlay', 'hyperpigmented dark brown macule')

texture.description: Surface characteristics (e.g., 'thick adherent silvery scales', 'smooth dome-shaped', 'crusted and ulcerated')

border.description: Border characteristics (e.g., 'sharply demarcated, slightly raised', 'irregular and asymmetric', 'diffuse and indistinct')

distribution.description: Anatomical location and pattern (e.g., 'bilateral extensor surfaces (elbows)', 'scalp and nasolabial folds')

size_extent.description: Estimated size or extent (e.g., '<1cm papule', '3-5cm plaque', 'diffuse patches covering forearms')

additional_features.description: Any other notable visual features (e.g., 'Auspitz sign visible', 'satellite lesions present', 'central ulceration')

image_quality.description: Overall image quality for clinical assessment

estimated_fitzpatrick.description: Estimated Fitzpatrick skin type from the image
